translations.web: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
translations.bsb: Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because its defilement brings destruction— a grievous destruction!
translations.kjv: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
translations.asv: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your resting-place; because of uncleanness that destroyeth, even with a grievous destruction.
